data.body: SC-REFERENCE-CORRECTION: This task's title and description reference 'SC6', but epic c13f-6196 only defines sc-1, sc-2, and sc-3. The work described — seeded phantom test + suggestion quality audit — functionally validates sc-2 (phantom mapping detection). Treat this task as covering sc-2 for the purposes of epic completion verification. Recommend the task title/description be updated on next edit pass to replace 'SC6' with 'sc-2', but the work scope itself is unchanged. No re-scoping required; this is a labeling correction only. Source: 2026-05-20 implementation-plan remediation against epic c13f-6196 SC↔AC coverage analysis.
